recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片免疫染色（抗原未標示）顯示細胞密度高，骨小樑間有大量棕色陽性細胞散布，與藍色陰性細胞交錯；需知道所用抗體才能判讀骨髓系成熟程度。
features: Hypercellular marrow with few fat spaces between trabeculae
Numerous brown-positive cells distributed diffusely in an interstitial pattern
Positive cells intermixed with hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells
No discrete clusters or sheets of positive cells
Specific antigen not indicated in the image
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy (antigen not specified) shows a hypercellular marrow in which numerous brown-positive cells are dispersed diffusely in an interstitial pattern among hematoxylin-counterstained negative cells. No sheets or aggregates of positive cells are seen. Interpretation depends on the antibody used; in severe congenital neutropenia, myeloid markers such as MPO typically highlight preserved early granulocytic precursors with a paucity of mature neutrophils.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow shows full granulocytic maturation to segmented neutrophils on H&E and aspirate, unlike maturation arrest.
AML shows sheets of CD34-positive blasts rather than a dispersed mixed population.
MDS shows multilineage dysplasia and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
